# HyperHeart

Original source: https://library.med.utah.edu/kw/pharm/hyperheart/

HyperHeart is hosted by the **Spencer S. Eccles Health Sciences Library, University of Utah**, in its Knowledge Weavers collection. The source page identifies **Quentin Roper of Massey University, New Zealand**, as the person who updated the interactive animation from Flash to HTML5. It does not identify him as the creator of all original artwork; no such ownership claim is made here.

License: **Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International (CC BY-NC 4.0)**. See [LICENSE.md](./LICENSE.md).

MedNerds contains an adapted interface and a native React/TypeScript reimplementation based on the original educational material. The seven tutorial image sets were extracted using the source atlas coordinates. Only exact `#006666` background pixels connected to image borders were made transparent. The illustrations, curves, original image labels, ECG relationships, and heart-sound relationships were not redrawn or reinterpreted.

The continuous playback correction also adapts source blood-flow motion paths, transform/visibility/opacity tracks, symbol shapes and time-marker tracks into typed data and native SVG overlays. These source-derived data/shapes, the original HyperHeart assets and their derived images remain under **CC BY-NC 4.0**, and are **not covered by the MedNerds MIT License**. The root MedNerds license is unchanged. Neither the institution nor the named contributor is represented as endorsing this adaptation.

The production application does not execute CreateJS, load the original JavaScript export, or depend on `_reference/` at runtime. Reference provenance and checksums are recorded in [asset-manifest.json](./asset-manifest.json). Phase/timeline findings and source limitations are recorded in [SOURCE_ANALYSIS.md](./SOURCE_ANALYSIS.md).

Visible UI attribution:

The control icons are a five-icon subset of the project's existing `@iconify-json/tabler` collection, **Tabler Icons (MIT)**, version 3.45.0, copyright (c) 2020–2026 Paweł Kuna. The original license is retained in [TABLER-LICENSE](./TABLER-LICENSE), from https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons/blob/v3.45.0/LICENSE. Their source bodies are regenerated by the same development script; no additional icon runtime is bundled.
